applies_to: open_composer/research/kernel search paths (mechanism_eval, layered_search, nested_walk_forward, expression_tree_search)
rationale: Thresholds carried over verbatim from the Work Item A gate recalibration (commit a4a5b07 and the 2026-08-26 plan), which replaced absolute CAGR and TQQQ-capture bars with QQQ-relative equivalents and lowered the DSR floor from 0.75 to 0.50 once the trial count became the clustered effective N rather than a lifetime cumulative 8195. They are recorded here unchanged so the kernel judges candidates against the same bar the campaign path does, fixed in advance of any kernel search result. Changing a number in this file must be its own commit, with its reason, before the run it applies to.
